description: This file defines a prompt management system for integrating Arize Phoenix with LiteLLM, enabling fetching, rendering, and managing prompt templates with support for workspace-based access control, templating via Jinja2, and seamless integration with other prompt management workflows.

classes.name: ArizePhoenixPromptTemplate
classes.description: Represents a prompt template loaded from Arize Phoenix with associated metadata and message components.

classes.name: ArizePhoenixTemplateManager
classes.description: Handles loading, parsing, and rendering prompt templates from Arize Phoenix, supporting templating and version management.

classes.name: ArizePhoenixPromptManager
classes.description: Integrates the Arize Phoenix prompt system into LiteLLM's prompt management framework, allowing prompt fetching, rendering, and integration with LLM calls.
